component.name: MarkView
component.summary: Write Markdown with a live preview

description.p: MarkView is a Markdown editor for GNOME. Write on one side and see the rendered document on the other as you type.

ul.li: Live preview that follows the system accent colour, fonts and light or dark style
Tabs, a tab overview and a list of recent files
GitHub-style alerts, footnotes, task lists and tables
Find and replace, PDF export and customisable shortcuts

description.p: Adds the desktop entry and app metadata, so MarkView shows up in the app grid and software centres.
A rebuilt interface on the latest GNOME platform, with tabs, recent files, a new layout switcher, a style switcher and many preview improvements.
